        investor_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('SIP', 'Lump Sum', 'Deposit') THEN -amount

    SELECT 
        investor_id,
        SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain

    SELECT

        AVG(shortfall) AS avg_goal_shortfall
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    WHERE shortfall IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),

    SELECT 
        p.investor_id,
        COALESCE(cf.net_cash_flow, 0) + COALESCE(hg.total_holding_gain, 0) - COALESCE(gs.avg_goal_shortfall, 0) AS composite_score

    LEFT JOIN HoldingGain hg ON p.investor_id = hg.investor_id
    LEFT JOIN GoalShortfall gs ON p.investor_id = gs.investor_id
    WHERE cf.investor_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND hg.investor_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND gs.investor_id IS NOT NULL
)

FROM CompositeScore
